cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me carry a box. Missing your birthday doesn't make me incompetent with your glassware; I'll pack it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I needed you then. You didn't show.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. Let me get one thing right today. Give me something fragile; I'll support the base, not drag it by the tape.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The birthday glasses. Still wrapped, since nobody came.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll keep them upright all the way. At the new place, let me unwrap two. Two, please; don't leave me packing them away again without you.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 competence claim and A3 careful base handling seek limited trust, but A5 repeated two and packing-again image add unclear emotional choreography.

relationship.evidence: B2 no-show hurt and B4 symbolic glasses both meaningfully change A offer.

heightening.evidence: B4 birthday glasses causes A5 careful carrying and desire to unwrap two, a strong direct connection before the tail.

specificity.evidence: A1 move and B4 unused birthday glasses make specific hurt and trust task clear.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 two-please repetition and packing-away tail are detachable after the useful shared-unwrapping request.
